items.title: FCC Moves to Open 1,050 MHz of Spectrum to Satellite Broadband
items.summary: The FCC plans to open 1,050 MHz in the 12.7 GHz and 42 GHz bands to expanded satellite use, adding capacity for broadband, mobile connectivity, inter-satellite links and ground networks.

items.title: 4iG and SpaceX Plan Starlink Mobile Rollout Across Hungary and Western Balkans
items.summary: 4iG and SpaceX plan direct-to-device Starlink services across four European markets, alongside secured government communications, but national spectrum approvals and key details of the proposed sovereign infrastructure remain unresolved.

items.title: Starlink’s Unconventional Approach to Cellular
items.summary: SpaceX is considering a terrestrial cellular network powered by Starlink satellite backhaul, but scarce spectrum, enormous capacity demands and entrenched rivals could make its boldest telecommunications gambit yet far harder to execute profitably at scale.

items.title: Poland Excluded from Starlink’s European Region: What Musk Dispute Reveals About Digital Sovereignty
items.summary: Poland's exclusion from Starlink's new European roaming region has triggered a dispute with Warsaw, exposing how private infrastructure providers can shape cross-border connectivity and raising questions about digital sovereignty, accountability, and internet governance in Europe.

items.title: From 300 to 150,000+: What MTN Nigeria’s FTTH Journey Teaches Us About Scaling Connectivity
items.summary: MTN Nigeria’s FTTH network has grown from barely 300 home connections to more than 150,000, showing how infrastructure, skilled people, vendor coordination and disciplined operating systems must evolve as connectivity moves from deployment to scale.

items.title: Ericsson lands private 5G CBRS network at Minneapolis airport
items.summary: Ericsson deployed a private 5G network at Minneapolis-St. Paul International Airport (MSP) using CBRS spectrum.

items.title: While Illinois lags on closing its digital divide, its citizens pick Starlink
items.summary: With a few exceptions, nearly every state is narrowing the gap between broadband performance in cities compared to rural areas, according to new research from Ookla.

items.title: Ooma’s StarDial provides voice add-on for Starlink broadband subscribers
items.summary: Ooma’ StarDial is targeted to Starlink internet users in rural, remote or off-grid locations who may want to also tap their satellite broadband service for voice.

items.title: Samsung eyes regional carriers to boost its US game in wireless
items.summary: Samsung is making inroads in the Tier 1 and 2 operator space, a market dominated by Ericsson and Nokia in their post-Huawei era.

items.title: Airspan wins UK funding to develop digital twin for high-altitude wireless networks
items.summary: Airspan has secured £2.3 million in funding from the UK's Advanced Research + Invention Agency (ARIA) to develop an AI-enabled digital twin platform aimed at modeling, testing and evaluating high-altitude platform station (HAPS) communications networks before deployment.

items.title: When Cell Towers Start to See: How ISAC Is Evolving Mobile Networks
items.summary: ISAC has the potential to transform mobile networks into intelligent sensing systems. Read Samsung Networks’ latest blog to learn more.

items.title: AT&T, T-Mobile and Verizon plans diverge on AI-RAN
items.summary: AI-RAN may be the end game, but the Big 3 are taking different paths to get there.

items.title: The optical network is becoming part of the AI machine
items.summary: As AI clusters grow larger, the connections between processors increasingly determine the performance of the entire system. Near-packaged optics (NPO) offers a practical way to bring optical connectivity closer to the silicon without sacrificing maintainability or supply-chain flexibility.

items.title: Nokia accelerates AI-RAN adoption as global operators embrace AI-native network evolution on NVIDIA platforms
items.summary: A1 Group, Chunghwa Telecom, du, e&, Mobily, stc, TPG Telecom and Zain Saudi are among a growing number of operators advancing AI-RAN proofs of concept and live trials with Nokia, using NVIDIA Aerial RAN Computer.

items.title: Huawei Cloud Stack powers new era of intelligence
items.summary: Huawei Cloud introduced an AI agent-ready hybrid cloud architecture at its Huawei Cloud event today.
